name: Admin Theme Change
description: Switches the active theme for selected paths or routes via a theme negotiator, configured as config entities.
project_description:
This theme change module is used to show ANY SELECTED theme based on selective routes/paths and render the selected theme for that route/path.

Theme Change module helps users to set the theme for the different path(s)/route(s).

 Note: If the user has permissions to view SELECTED theme, then the only theme will be accessible.

Ex: If any authenticated user wants to view '/abc' route in admin theme and '/xyz' in CUSTOM theme this module will help to show selected routes/paths in respectively selected theme.

 Added Delete Option and Wildcard for Paths.
